subject: Invitation to Company Networking Event
body: Dear valued client, We are excited to invite you to our upcoming networking event on May 15th at the Grand Hotel. This will be a great opportunity for you to connect with industry professionals and expand your business network. The event will include keynote speakers, interactive sessions, and a cocktail reception. Please RSVP by May 5th to secure your spot. We look forward to seeing you there! Best regards, The Events Team
